summary: Keep. Operator site + its Good Sam booking engine: 31 power-and-water sites + a handful of non-electric (tents and smaller campers), 2026 electric $35 (base moved from the $25 non-electric), gate entry $10/day; 2027 season May 15 - Sep 7 from the engine; booking window 146 days. Not on Sask Parks' booking system: there is no campgroundDetails.do page for it. Not waterfront confirmed (riverbank woods). Pin fine.
flags: WEBSITE / BOOKING LINK: there is no parks.saskatchewan.ca campgroundDetails.do page for this campground: it is not in the tourism Sask Parks data (parks.csv/listings.csv have no Borden entry) and the operator books on its own Good Sam engine (https://reserve.campgroundbooking.com/borden-bridge-campground -> reserve.campgroundreservations.com/search_sites?gs_campground_id=202322475). Stored website lines both answer 200 and describe this campground; keep them. booking.platform written 'operator' with that url.

FEES: base moved $25 -> $35. The $25 non-electric sites are described as 'a handful of non-electric sites for tents and smaller self contained campers', so a 23-ft motorhome's fit is not established; the electric sites with water ($35) are the sure RV night. The surcharges.electric $10 is cleared (the $35 is now the base). Gate entry 'Daily Entry: $10.00' (per party/vehicle not stated) kept in fees.note rather than fees.entrance for that reason.

HOOKUPS: amperage is not stated on any operator page or reachable in the engine (the engine refused to list sites before its 146-day window: 'max advance is 146, days after Tue Apr 13 2027 ... isn't available'). Electric stays unset.
SITES: no total count posted ('31 sites' with power and water plus 'a handful' non-electric); count left unset.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept although the operator says 'Located on the banks of the North Saskatchewan River' and Tourism Saskatchewan 'the beautiful riverfront setting' (contrary claims -> re-audited). On Esri z17 the westmost loop's units (~52.3757,-107.1466) sit ~30-45 m from the river behind a continuous wooded riverbank; the operator itself says river access is by 'several locations'. No site has open ground to the water.
PIN: stored 52.37575,-107.1438 is inside the campground (between the loops, ~150 m east of the west loop). No move.
HORSES: services list an 'Equestrian non-electric area' (separate area per its wording; not mixed into the electric loops as far as the pages say).

LONG-STAY: 'SEASONAL SITES AVAILABLE NOW!' leads the home page; seasonal $2200 electric. Nightly rates are posted and the engine sells nights (instant booking), so ordinary nights are sold; seasonal share not posted.
